text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the dance studio, I spotted Yamanin 
Zephyr staying behind to dance all by 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No... It still doesn't feel quite right...
choice_data_list: I think the dance was pretty good, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... However, the stirring winds in 
my heart will not settle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"To someone like me, who has grown up 
listening to the wind's songs and watching 
the swaying trees dance, worldly music and 
dancing just don't feel quite right."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter which way the wind blows, the 
song and dance for the assignment piece 
remain unchanged...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it is a melody out of step with 
the current winds, continuing to play 
against the grain would be—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I won't say it's like a winter gale in 
midsummer, but it is quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always natural and true to herself, she 
might find this somewhat suffocating. Even 
so, her assignments must be properly 
completed.
choice_data_list:
Sometimes you just have to ride against 
the headwind.

How about inviting a breeze that matches 
the song?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A headwind, is it?
choice_data_list:
There will be times when an unfavorable 
wind blows, after all.

There will be times when an unfavorable 
wind blows, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is... a very reasonable point.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nature is a collection of free and fickle 
phenomena. Just when you think a gentle 
breeze has been granted, you find yourself 
utterly tossed about...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A headwind is still a wind. In that 
case, I must adapt and master it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Reading the wind and adapting to it... 
That is how one survives in nature, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having convinced herself with her own 
unique theory, Yamanin Zephyr went on to 
silently devote herself to training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Draw in customers, you say?
choice_data_list:
Let's do it with someone whose breeze 
matches the song.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'wind' she mentions here might very 
well refer to her own feelings or the mood 
of the room. If that's the case, involving 
others might help improve things.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see... Then if it's this song—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you care to play along with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt that if it were with you, Trainer, 
a favorable tailwind would surely blow our 
way.
choice_data_list:
But I can't sit in on your assessment 
test, you know?

Still, I won't be able to sit in on your 
assignment test, you know?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They never said Trainers weren't allowed 
to accompany us. Now, let us summon the 
wind together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, we performed our song 
and dance together with Yamanin Zephyr in 
front of a wryly smiling teacher.
